label: Braced and waiting
summary: The world waited on Washington. Trump confirmed 'minor' US strikes on Iran's Qeshm island, the first since the midterms, while claiming progress in talks; Qatar urged both sides not to wait for a 'perfect moment'. Brent stayed choppy near $100. Russia hit Kyiv with missiles days before Abu Dhabi talks, and strikes on a Taiz market in Yemen reportedly killed at least 30. In eastern DRC, attackers killed 33 and scattered Ebola patients; the UN said it can shelter only a fraction of those displaced by Sudan's war. Wall Street steadied after Thursday's rout on strong jobs data, though Asian tech stocks plunged. Paraguay removed Peña, now under house arrest. US measles cases hit a 35-year high, and October was the hottest on record as COP31 approached. New Zealand voted peacefully; counting had barely begun. The weighted formula gave 41; no editorial adjustment.
